text_block_list.text:
One day, while waiting for the bus to head 
to the shopping center—
(……*pssshh*)

A familiar face stepped off the bus. It 
was Tucker Brine, who continues to explore 
ultimate training environments for 
Umamusume on uninhabited islands.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Ngh... ahh!?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... *pant* *pant*. Is there a 
place... where I can rest...
choice_data_list: タッカーさん！？だ、大丈夫ですか！？

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant* *pant*... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: ...Whew—— How pathetic of me.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because I lived on an uninhabited 
island for so long, I've developed quite 
the motion sickness. Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Urk... Sorry for the trouble. I should be 
heading off now... *whew* *pant*

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant* *pant*... No good. I have an 
important meeting to get to.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
An idea for a new training facility―― I 
must make it a reality……

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
You... don't need to follow me. Please, 
don't stop me...!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me go! Do not rob me of my 
reason for living!
choice_data_list: そんな状態で放っておけません

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
To create an environment where Umamusume 
can run to their heart's content, 
unleashing their full potential...! A 
dream environment like that!
choice_data_list: えっ！？それって、どういう……

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Envisioning that ideal future is my 
mission... No――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: It's pure, absolute bliss!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
So you understand. Then I shall take my 
leave――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
What?! You don't need to do anything of 
the sort――
choice_data_list: 俺も行きます……肩、掴まってください
私も行きます……肩、掴まってください

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...No, this is to seize the future. I'll 
gladly take you up on that offer!!

With steady, resolute strides, Tucker 
Brine headed toward the meeting spot!
